seoTitle: Bact-T Drop - CRD & Coryza Support for Poultry
seoDescription: Bact-T Drop from ZenAvian Healthcare supports poultry farms facing CRD and infectious coryza-related bacterial challenges.
summary: Bact-T Drop is positioned as a poultry product for CRD and infectious coryza-related bacterial challenges.
educationalNote: CRD and infectious coryza can present with respiratory signs such as coughing, sneezing and nasal discharge; accurate diagnosis is important because respiratory disease complexes can involve multiple pathogens.
